title: WASD UI
cue: styled menus and HUD: themes, bars, damage numbers, toasts
summary: Six looks for every control in the game, so no menu ships in Godot's gray, and a HUD's pieces: bars, floating damage numbers, toasts, key prompts, a crosshair, a radar, a hurt flash, and fades.
useWhen: The game has any menu, settings screen, or HUD: health and stamina bars, damage numbers, pickup and checkpoint messages, an interaction prompt, a crosshair, a radar. Install it with the first control, so every screen is styled from the start.
avoidWhen: The interface is drawn entirely from the game's own art, with its own Theme and textures.
